frontier.notes: the all-Arena reprofile: 20 of 21 cells on identical tasks, replicates and route, cost is provider-reported; Codex × Kimi K3 is carried over from the superseded publication at its standardized cost · 5/21 observations are nondominated on the empirical means · large filled/labeled = frontier · small open = dominated · icon = harness · Pareto membership is descriptive; intervals show uncertainty and can overlap · cost is token usage repriced under one frozen price schedule (agentbrane-research-2026-09-01-v3) so systems billed through different routes stay comparable; it need not equal what was actually paid · bootstrap frequency is not a posterior probability · The cost axis is logarithmic because the included systems span more than three orders of magnitude.
